title: My daily life and my preferences
objective: Parler de ses habitudes, comparer des routines et exprimer ses préférences

steps.title: Warm-up and retrieval
steps.student_instruction: Write three activities you do after school. Share one with a partner.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Recueillir des exemples, reformuler sans interrompre; noter les acquis.

steps.title: Listening: two routines
steps.student_instruction: Listen to the volunteer reading the two short routines twice. Identify who plays football and who reads.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Lire deux fois: Alex: I usually play football after school. I sometimes read in the evening. Sam: I often read after school. I never play football on weekdays. Faire justifier avec les mots entendus.

steps.title: Language focus
steps.student_instruction: Complete: I ___ play football. She ___ reading. Ask: How often do you read?
steps.facilitator_instruction: Présent simple: I play / she plays; adverbes always, usually, often, sometimes, never; I like + -ing.

steps.title: Differentiated practice
steps.student_instruction: Complete your A, B or C activity sheet; then compare answers in pairs.
steps.facilitator_instruction: A: étayage et banque de mots; B: phrases autonomes; C: comparer et justifier. Donner une aide sans dévoiler le corrigé.

steps.title: Pair interviews
steps.student_instruction: Interview a partner about routines and preferences; report one difference.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Binômes; observer questions, réponses et intelligibilité. Faire tourner les rôles.

steps.title: Exit ticket
steps.student_instruction: Write one sentence about your partner and one question you can now ask.
steps.facilitator_instruction: Collecter deux traces courtes et noter les difficultés récurrentes.

sheets.student_content: Complete using always / sometimes / never: (1) I ___ eat breakfast. (2) I ___ play tennis after school. Then write: I like ___ (read).
sheets.facilitator_correction: Réponses personnelles possibles pour 1 et 2 si cohérentes; I like reading.

sheets.student_content: Write five sentences about your week. Include two frequency adverbs and two preferences. Ask a classmate two questions.
sheets.facilitator_correction: Exemple: I usually walk to school. I sometimes play chess. I like drawing. I prefer reading because it is relaxing. How often do you play chess? What do you like doing?

sheets.student_content: Compare your routine with a partner's in 7–9 sentences. Explain two differences and justify one preference.
sheets.facilitator_correction: Production ouverte; critères: comparaison explicite, fréquence cohérente, questions pertinentes, justification with because.

criteria: L'élève formule une question au présent simple
